definition: the part of an object you hold to use or move it
description: A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.
